In-app wallet

title: Ilado FMS
summary: Multi-tenant farm management SaaS: each farm business gets an isolated workspace covering crops, livestock, equipment, inventory, HR/payroll, accounting and reporting.
problem: Farm businesses need one system for operations and finance, and each business's data must be completely isolated from every other tenant's.
solution: Schema-per-tenant PostgreSQL: each tenant's data lives in its own schema with no shared tenant_id columns, so cross-tenant reads are structurally impossible. Tenants are routed by subdomain; a request interceptor resolves the tenant and Hibernate sets the search_path for each connection.
highlights: Schema-per-tenant isolation with subdomain routing (e.g. acme.farmms.com)
JWT auth with short-lived access tokens, refresh-token rotation and a cross-tenant token check
Database-driven RBAC with 50+ permission codes enforced by a custom @RequiresPermission AOP annotation; revocations apply immediately
Audit logging and time-limited admin impersonation, every step recorded
Double-entry general ledger, budgets, payroll with Kenyan statutory deductions
FEFO batch inventory with purchase orders and goods-received notes
React frontend with reusable paginated CRUD hooks, React Hook Form and an Axios client that refreshes tokens automatically
Dockerised with Docker Compose and Traefik; Flyway migrations

title: Charity Campaign Management System
summary: Campaign management platform with role-based access, SMS outreach to 10K+ voters and an API tuned from 1.2 s to 220 ms.
solution: REST APIs secured with JWT and a three-level RBAC model, a React front end, and an SMS integration for mass outreach, shipped through CI/CD pipelines.
highlights: REST APIs with JWT authentication and three-level RBAC
Query optimisation cut API response time from 1.2 s to 220 ms (82%)
SMS API integration for 10K+ voter campaigns
Deployed with CI/CD pipelines
results: 82% faster API responses after query optimisation.

title: RentEase
summary: Complete rental management platform: dashboard, tenants, properties, payments with receipts, AI rent-price suggestions and automated reminders.
problem: Property managers juggle tenants, payments and communication across spreadsheets and phone calls.
solution: One platform for the whole rental workflow, with data segregated per manager and role-based access.
highlights: Dashboard with revenue, occupancy and overdue payments
Tenant and property management with full payment history
Payments hub with rent calculator and one-click receipts
AI rent-price suggestions and AI-written payment reminders (Genkit + Gemini)
Event-driven SMS and email notifications
Announcements and direct or group chat with tenants
RBAC with data segregated per manager
